_comment: Provider template — Claude (Anthropic official endpoint). In the DSH port the ORCHESTRATOR is DeepSeek, so Claude is heterogeneous by construction: no BASE_URL override, the claude CLI's own credentials route the call. No _token_env: the wrapper skips token injection and the CLI uses its native auth. ROUTING ONLY (no secret). See model-routing.md. ADR #40. EXTERNAL-HARNESS OPT-IN: substrate claude-code spawns the Claude Code CLI — a FOREIGN harness dragged into a DSH run. It is retained only for backends that expose no DSH adapter; the DSH-native default is profiles/pi-ai.json (substrate dsh).
